rows.label: Energy Lab: Lanka, then Arca Plasmor
rows.note: 3 days for the Arca Plasmor research

conditions: Ghost (x1) tier pays 7,500 credits, 200 Fieldron Samples, 12,000 Salvage, 3,750 Circuits and 8 Gallium for the Arca Plasmor research; bigger clans pay x3, x10, x30 or x100.
In an established clan this is already done and costs you nothing.

groups.activity: Corpus-side Invasions, or Orb Vallis Tier 4 bounty
groups.meta: 3 per Invasion; 2 per Tier 4 stage reward

rows.label: Fieldron
rows.alt: or craft from Fieldron Samples, 12h each

conditions: Invasion rewards pay out only when the invasion resolves, which can take a day or more.
Fieldron only drops from the Tier 4 (level 30-50) Orb Vallis bounty, rotation A, best on stage 1 at 33%.
bonuses: Rare and Reinforced Corpus storage containers can also drop built Fieldron.

disclosures.title: crafting from scratch
disclosures.body: Each Fieldron needs its own Energy Lab blueprint (15,000 credits) plus 15,000 credits, 10 Fieldron Samples, 1 Control Module, 500 Salvage and 250 Plastids, 12h to build. For all 5: 50 Fieldron Samples, 5 more Control Modules and 60 hours of Foundry time. Nekros, Khora or Hydroid in a Corpus Dark Sector survival pulls samples fast.

disclosures.title: the Tier 4 bounty loop
disclosures.body: Open a Solaris base so every bounty is Tier 4, run a stage-1 cache hunt, take the stage reward and abandon during the next stage, then repeat. Reddit calls this tier 2; the wiki drop tables put Fieldron on Tier 4 only.

groups.activity: Exterminate or Capture; break containers and open lockers
bonuses: One mission is usually enough; bring a loot frame if drops are slow.

rows.label: Arca Plasmor
rows.note: 25,000 cr, 5 Fieldron, 25 Control Module, 925 Cryotic, 1 Forma

disclosures.title: not the Tenet Arca Plasmor
disclosures.body: The Tenet Arca Plasmor is a separate Mastery item from the Railjack Ergo Glast system. Owning one does not cover the other.
